Its true predicate is a conjunction of two independent facts: (i) did the weights move in this run, and (ii) did the data those weights were fitted to change. The shipped tool estimates BOTH with wall-clock proxies. train_seconds is a proxy for (i) that is strictly dominated by ckpt_older_than_result (a run that trains necessarily rewrites last.pt): 0 unique true positives, 62 false alarms in 859 legs. ckpt_predates_data_change is a proxy for (ii) with no per-dataset resolution. M2 (ESTABLISHED) - fact (ii) has a split the round has been treating as one thing: a TRAIN-relevant data change invalidates the weights, a TEST-relevant one does not. The 18 ac legs (test-split trim only, weights valid) and the 18 pfc legs (whole-box swap, weights invalid) carry the identical mechanical signature and opposite scientific verdicts. Any instrument that hashes 'the dataset' as one blob keeps conflating them.

6_analysis.falsification_postmortem: F1 fired on the letter and the orchestrator adjudicated it METROLOGY-LIMITED; this reanalysis confirms the adjudication and identifies the mechanism precisely. The clause set a single fixed tolerance (1e-9 relative) for a quantity whose achievable precision is a PER-DATASET property of the cell's arithmetic, and it was written before that property had been measured on any dataset. Turn 2 measured it on all ten: the round-off band of the frozen floor arms spans 6.03e-11 (cahn_hilliard) to 1.005e-8 (fluid) - a 167x range - so a single tolerance is above the seam on six datasets and below it on four. ifc_heat is one of the four: its own band is 7.854e-9 and the observed deviation 1.106e-9 is 7.1x inside it. The clause therefore did not detect a floor-reproduction failure; it detected that its own tolerance was set below the instrument's precision on that cell. Two refinements to the adjudication as written: (a) the correct comparand is ifc_heat's own band, not sod_1d's 7.74e-8 - the conclusion is unchanged but the reasoning becomes within-dataset; (b) the batch-2 contract change must define the seam as the cell's ULP round-off band, not as the float64-vs-float32 path difference, because the latter is identically zero on natively-float32 datasets (fluid) where the true band is 1.005e-8. F2/F3/F4 all confirmed and nothing in this reanalysis disturbs them: the rung seam is real, mdd_scored is far from negligible on the copy-LF cells (0.171/1.674/0.311, driving tau_abs/tau_rel to 3.16x/62.05x/7.06x), and no certified seed_mce exceeded twice its provisional constant. The card's substantive content stands; what the reanalysis changes is the instrument specification the card ships downstream.
